verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents Resolve, a built-in AI agent that takes a production error and produces a pull request, writing a tested fix and opening the PR for the user to approve. That is genuine in-product task delegation. The evidence covers only this single task type (error-to-fix PRs), and the documentation consists of brief claims. The MCP server is a separate integration for external AI tools and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: delegation beyond error fixing (broader assistant tasks), in-depth documentation of Resolve's workflow and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as claimed.
